## Earnie 2.6.1-beta.2

Korrektur der Vorzeichen bei Batterie- und Hausverbrauchsleistung: Home-Assistant-Nutzer sehen jetzt den richtigen Live-Hausverbrauch; bitte prüfen, ob die Batterieleistung beim Entladen positiv angezeigt wird.

Community **pre-release** (hotfix line from **2.6.0**, follows **2.6.1-beta.1**). Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **Unified power sign convention** (normative, see `docs/spec/ehal.md`): every flow *into the house* is positive — `P_cons = P_PV + P_Grid + P_Bat` with grid `+` = import and battery `+` = discharge
- **Home Assistant / OpenEMS:** Live house load no longer subtracts battery discharge (battery was added with the wrong sign)
- **Derived house load** (`sens_power_consumers` when not mapped) now `PV + grid + ESS` in all adapters (was `PV − grid − ESS`)
- **Loxone:** `Earnie_Batterie_Leistung` is read as `+` = discharge like EHAL; `sens_ess_power` now carries the correct sign (Live house load unchanged)
- Includes all fixes from **2.6.1-beta.1** ([#24](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/issues/24) hourly CSV ZOH, HA tariffs path, EEG catalog row removed)

### Please check (HA / Loxone)

- **Home Assistant:** if you negated the battery power in the EHAL mapping (`ehal.ha.sign`) so that the old house load looked plausible, review it — after mapping the battery entity must be **positive while discharging**.
- **Loxone:** `Earnie_Batterie_Leistung` (or the EFM storage meter) must be **positive while discharging**; Earnie no longer inverts it. Huawei registers 37113 (grid, `+` = export) and 37765 (battery, `+` = charge) must both be negated in Loxone.

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.1-beta.2` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`) after you approve **promote**
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.6.0**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
